description: Frozen evaluation cases for one skill: trigger cases (does the right skill fire, and do neighbouring skills stay quiet?) and capability cases (does the agent follow the skill on a fixed prompt?). Specs are linted in CI with no model spend; live execution is a separate, explicitly opened step.

skill_invoked.description: Trigger cases only: true for prompts that must invoke the skill, false for neighbouring prompts that must not.

skill.description: Skill name; must match a skill directory under packs/*/skills/ and the spec file name.

title: Skill Eval Spec
